text: Zoho and QuickBooks? There's no single switch.
Zoho CRM syncs customers, vendors and products both ways.
Estimates, invoices and purchase orders come from QuickBooks into CRM, read-only.
Zoho Inventory and Billing send invoices, credit notes and payments to QuickBooks Online.
Zoho Expense sends approved reports as bills or journals. Analytics only reads.
One QuickBooks company per Zoho organisation, and the same base currency.
Tax rates must match exactly. Map non-taxable lines to a zero per cent tax.
Invoice when a deal is won? Use Zoho Flow, Deluge or a custom build.
Read the full guide at zudoworks.com
